number_differences: Only the Table 7 exponent notation: the PDF text glues the superscript exponent to its base ('10−1', '100', '101', '102', three of each), while the CSV cells write it as '× 10^-1', '× 10^0', '× 10^1', '× 10^2' (the parser then sees '10' x9, '-1' x3, '0' x3, '1' x3, '2' x3 as extra). Mantissas and standard errors (3.51, 0.06, 4.77, 0.03, ..., 3.51, 0.07) match exactly; all 12 cells were compared with a 400-dpi crop and with the TeX.
independent_parser_number_differences: Same tokens and same cause as number_differences (superscript exponent glued to the base 10 in the PDF text).
